before: Yao Hong, courtesy Yuanzi, was Yao Xing's firstborn.
after: Yao Hong, whose courtesy name was Yuanzi, was Yao Xing’s eldest son.
sourceReason: 長子 identifies the eldest son. “Firstborn” omits that he is a son and could imply that he is the eldest of all the children.
sourceWitness: 姚泓，字元子，興之長子也。
